title: Metrics Event
description: Aggregate metrics for a time period. Contains only counters — no individual identifiers. Counts below 10 are suppressed to protect privacy.

period.description: The time period these metrics cover.

variantId.description: Which A/B variant these counts belong to.

counts.description: Aggregate counters for each outcome. Any count below 10 should be reported as null or omitted (small-count suppression).

suppressedSmallCounts.description: True if any counts in this event were suppressed because they fell below the minimum threshold (10).
